citations.claim: First violation at step 1: controller force exceeds fmax; body accelerated to speed 0.065 consistent with ~6.5N force
Body started at rest so excess force comes from controller law plus noise, not initial motion

counterfactual.change: Set controller noise 1 -> 0; clamped velocity-error force (kp*vcmd capped at 5N) no longer has noise added post-clamp, so force stays within fmax and no violation

explanation: Seeded sensor noise is added to the controller force after the fmax clamp (or clamp is applied before noise), so commanded force 6.5N exceeds fmax 5N at step 1. With noise=0 the same scenario stays within limit, confirming noise is the cause.
vision_note: The controller-driven body appears as a red dot on the left, far from the green waypoint in the upper right. Between step 0 and step 1 it shows almost no movement and remains well inside the arena.
